title: Scenic Japan in Three Cities
alt: Itsukushima shrine torii gate at high tide, Miyajima
transport: Shinkansen bullet train, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Shinjuku, minutes from the station

activities.name: Tokyo city tour with lunch
activities.description: A full day by coach from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and Asakusa, with lunch included.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Two nights in Shinjuku to start, with a free first evening and a full guided city day.

stops.name: Hiroshima
stops.subtitle: Hiroshima to Miyajima
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel attached to Hiroshima station

activities.name: Hiroshima and Miyajima tour
activities.description: The Peace Memorial Park and museum in the morning, then the ferry to Miyajima for the floating torii gate and Itsukushima shrine.

program.name: Hiroshima
program.description: Two nights beside the station, with a quiet arrival day and the Peace Memorial Park paired with Miyajima.

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.subtitle: Kyoto to Nara and Osaka

activities.name: Kyoto and Nara with buffet lunch
activities.description: A full day from Kyoto for Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, then the deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara, with a buffet lunch.

program.name: Kyoto
program.description: Three nights in the old capital with a guided day to Nara, a free day for the temples and a short hop to Osaka to fly home.

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Shinjuku hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Tokyo Metropolitan Building viewing decks, free of charge
2: Breakfast, then a full day coach tour of the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
3: Breakfast and check out, then transfer to the station
Shinkansen bullet train west to Hiroshima
Check in at your hotel beside the station
Rest of the day free in the city
4: Breakfast, then the Peace Memorial Park and museum
The A-Bomb Dome and the memorial cenotaph
The floating torii gate and Itsukushima shrine
5: Breakfast and check out, then back to the station
Check in at your hotel on Shijo street
Optional: an evening walk through Gion and Pontocho
6: Breakfast, then a full day with your guide
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara
7: Breakfast and a free day in Kyoto
Optional: the bamboo grove and monkey park at Arashiyama
Optional: Fushimi Inari's torii gate paths at dawn
Optional: Nishiki market and the Gion lanes
8: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Transfer to Osaka and on to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Three nights in Kyoto with one of them free is the right shape. Fushimi Inari at seven in the morning is worth the alarm.
expert.tip: Each hotel is a step from a main station, so the two travel days cost you almost nothing in time.

summary: Eight days across three cities: Shinjuku with a guided city day, two nights in Hiroshima for the Peace Memorial Park and Miyajima, then three in Kyoto with Nara, a free day and a short hop to Osaka for the flight home.
included: Included: 7 nights with daily breakfast; bullet train from Tokyo to Hiroshima and on to Kyoto; private airport transfers; full day Tokyo city tour with lunch; Hiroshima and Miyajima tour; Kyoto and Nara day tour with buffet lunch.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
